batch: South Asia official sources — initial candidate batch
policy: All records intentionally start pending_validation. They are not active or healthy. RSS/Atom records require endpoint validation and licence review; HTML listings require an HTML collection adapter before activation. Licence terms must be reviewed separately. Additional Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal and Sri Lanka public statistical portal candidates were added in this revision; all remain pending_validation.
